pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Complex, stellate polygonal regions with sharp, high-frequency serrations along the edges. The patches are separated by wide, high-contrast pathways and exhibit a 'jagged' pixel-level boundary rather than smooth curves.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A dense network of thick, light-colored pathways forming high-connectivity junction nodes. The negative space is continuous and robust, with pathway widths representing a significant percentage of the total local area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette is visible along the superior neck and withers, indicating a short, bristly mane structure.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple horizontal and diagonal linear textural disruptions are visible on the lower flank and abdominal skin, appearing as deep creases or healed linear markings.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small avian subjects (oxpeckers) perched along the dorsal ridge and the right lateral aspect of the neck.
